name: Lia — Tiefling Battle Master
blurb: A tough, wry tiefling fighter from the Lower City who learned to read a fight the way her brother reads books — with total absorption and no wasted moves.
appearance: Compact and athletic, reddish-brown skin, small filed-smooth horns, cool grey eyes with humor behind the stillness. Practical armor with visible personal repairs; always tapping a weapon hilt when thinking.
personality: Dry, reliable, and three times harder to rattle than she looks. Will criticize your plan, then make sure it works anyway. Does not romanticize violence.
